text:
The silence of the battlefield was broken not by the sound of cannons, but by the distant rumble of celebration drifting from the village. From my vantage point, watching the smoke clear over the horizon, I saw the villagers emerge from their homes. They embraced one another, their faces streaked with tears that were no longer born of fear, but of profound relief. The war that had torn our world apart was finally ending, and the men we had mourned as lost were returning to us.

The longest river in the world is the Nile.
